blocking_findings.summary: The actual full sentiment executor preserves an untrusted fusion polarity in compact State and overwrites an unknown fusion model status with the selected-attempt status VALID.
evidence: agents/sentiment_agent.py reads fear_greed_result['polarity'], derives a canonical polarity only when it is null, then stores the existing raw value in state['sentiment_polarity']; the compact summary is built from that state value.

The executor overwrites fear_greed_result['status'] with the selected-attempt status before monthly feature construction, so an original unknown fusion status becomes VALID and is counted as available provenance.

The new full-agent PRIVATE_SENTINEL test mocks agent._graph.ainvoke and returns a fabricated final_state with sentiment_polarity=None; it therefore does not execute or validate the real executor propagation path.

Independent real-pipeline mocked-provider counterexample using three temporally valid evidence items and unknown/overlong/malformed model statuses plus fusion polarity PRIVATE_SENTINEL produced: private_in_summary=True, private_in_slot=False, summary_polarity='PRIVATE_SENTINEL', slot_polarity=None, slot_degraded=True, model_statuses={'finbert':'UNKNOWN','vader':'UNKNOWN','fusion':'VALID','selected_attempt':'VALID'}.

This violates OBS-06-A3-001's finite-allowlist/privacy requirement and the fail-closed provenance contract: arbitrary provider text crosses compact persisted State and an untrusted fusion result is reported as healthy provenance.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The implementation artifact reports 177 passed and 3 deselected, whereas the authoritative marker-correct independent QA run reports 175 passed and 5 deselected.
non_blocking_findings.disposition: Non-blocking because the QA artifact records the authoritative selector behavior and all 175 selected Stage 06 tests passed; the discrepancy is limited to two database-marked tests.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Live provider/network behavior was not exercised.
non_blocking_findings.disposition: Expected under the offline review policy; deterministic mocked-provider and fail-closed tests cover the contracted boundary.

required_rework: Preserve the fusion model's original canonical status separately from the selected-attempt status; never overwrite model health with attempt health before monthly feature construction.

Canonicalize fusion polarity and every provider-controlled status before assigning typed State or compact summary fields; unknown, overlong, or malformed values must fail closed and must not contribute model availability or provenance.

Replace or supplement the mocked-_graph.ainvoke full-agent privacy test with a test that executes the real graph/executor path using mocked providers and proves PRIVATE_SENTINEL is absent from typed slots, compact summary, logs, progress, traces, and Sentry while unknown fusion status is excluded from healthy provenance.
Re-run the complete marker-correct Stage 06 offline suite and all temporal, MCP identity, partial aggregate, low-coverage, and observability counterexamples.

resolved_findings.evidence: Direct-helper and declared full-agent counterexamples for one-model failure, fusion failure, and low coverage now propagate explicit availability, missing_sources, degraded_reasons, model_statuses, and contributor-only model provenance.
A future effective_from timestamp is rejected even when published_at is historical.
Future same-URL chunks are filtered before URL grouping and cannot borrow an older sibling timestamp.
Missing MCP identity fails closed before tool dispatch.
